title: Depot: establish authenticated read-only account usage evidence
reason: Acceptance requires an authorized read-only usage path with the required credential type, and the recorded probe shows the held credential cannot provide it: depot.core.v1.UsageService/GetUsage returned code unauthenticated demanding an organization token created in Organization Settings > API Tokens, which is user-only account access.

title: Depot: verify aggregate spending control for the USD 200 ceiling
reason: Acceptance requires authorized account-level probes of every metered product control, aggregate admission behavior with in-flight reservations, and plan-change behavior (human-only account access; the user token cannot query usage per #999), and bullet 2 leaves an either/or: rely on verified caps or explicitly retain a bounded allocation; the maintainer comment keeps the aggregate-control criteria open against the no-overage model.

title: Depot: reconcile cache policy limits and billable storage evidence

title: electron-infra distribution unit tests omit the unknown-argument and unknown-target error paths
reason: Only one toThrow case exists (distribution.unit.test.ts:154 for --target without value, verified count 1) while the documented throws at distribution-args.ts:81 (unknown token) and distribute.ts:98 (unknown target keys) have no tests; TCV named and the body specifies both cases in the existing toThrow style.

title: Electron desktop-app TypeScript packages omit region markers on substantial code blocks
reason: All 50 TypeScript files across electron-infra, file-manager-electron, and electron-counter lack ST2 markers (main.ts 561 lines, strip.ts 554, render-dom.ts 545) while 342 of 1048 package/module sources mark sections; body names the section groupings and the largest modules with lint/type-check-still-passing acceptance.

title: llama.ts stop() can wait forever for an already-emitted child exit event and wedge the daemon loop
reason: llama.ts attaches no exit/error listener at spawn (:75) and stop() calls currentServer.kill() (:151) before currentServer.on('exit') (:162), so an already-emitted exit leaves the promise unsettled and cycle() hangs; start() (:71) also treats dead handles as live. Body prescribes once(exit)/once(error) at spawn, early return when exitCode/signalCode is set, and the already-exited unit test.

title: syslog.ts emit() voids a rejecting spawn promise so a failed logger run terminates the daemon
reason: syslog.ts:27 voids a nano-spawn promise that rejects when logger is missing (the :26 comment claims errors are ignored but an unhandled rejection kills the daemon), and index.ts:64 void shutdown() has the same shape; LG2 named and the body prescribes a never-rejecting wrapper with stderr fallback and the logger-absent acceptance.

title: cycle() probes the screen lock outside its try block so a gdbus failure kills the daemon
reason: cycle.ts:92 awaits isScreenLocked() before the try at :103 that guards capture/analysis/notification, so a gdbus rejection (screenlock.ts:20 spawn) propagates through void main() (index.ts:119) and ends the daemon; body prescribes moving the probe inside the try (or treating probe failure as not-locked with a warning) and states the gdbus-absent acceptance.

title: index.ts shutdown() leaves the 5-minute interval timer armed so SIGTERM does not end the daemon
reason: The loop awaits intervalDelay's setTimeout(resolve, INTERVAL_MS) (index.ts:105-110, INTERVAL_MINUTES=5 at :22) and shutdown() only flips state.running (:54), with no clearTimeout in the package, so SIGTERM leaves the process alive up to 5 minutes (past systemd TimeoutStopSec 90s); body prescribes a timer handle or AbortController race cleared in shutdown with the ~1s SIGTERM exit acceptance.

title: Expected-error catch blocks in llama.ts, lock.ts, and capture.ts drop the caught value without logging
reason: Six Error.isError catches (llama.ts:139/237/199, lock.ts:245/301, capture.ts:70) rethrow only non-Errors and comment away the Error case, violating LG2 while cycle.ts shows the caughtValueText pattern; body prescribes debug-level logging of the caught value at each site with the pkill-failure-visible debug line acceptance.

title: hall-monitor logging bypasses module-logger tagged loggers and embeds manual [tag] message prefixes
reason: hall-monitor uses a hand-rolled logger(1) wrapper (syslog.ts:99) and 26 messages with manual [cycle]/[lock]/[hall-monitor] prefixes (index.ts:53), against TLG/LG1, and cycle.ts:189-190 plus notification.ts:35-36 duplicate errors via console.error; body prescribes a module-logger-interface syslog sink wrapped with tagged({tag: fn.name, l}) and deleting the duplicates, with the stated acceptance.

title: captureScreenshot and captureWebcam are hand-written twins and the ffmpeg spawn-collect shape recurs in blackdetect
reason: captureScreenshot (capture.ts:53-137) and captureWebcam (:153-205) share the identical chunks/await once close/Buffer.concat/empty-throw body and isBlackFrame (blackdetect.ts:26-68) repeats the skeleton over stderr with no owner; TWS/GRW named and the body prescribes a runFfmpeg({args, stdio, source}) helper with one-implementation acceptance.

title: killExisting sends SIGTERM without a guard so an exiting owner aborts lock takeover
reason: lock.ts:272 sends SIGTERM via bare process.kill so an owner exiting after findSocketOwnerPid (:269 slow /proc walk) throws ESRCH and aborts takeover, while the SIGKILL call at :291-302 is already guarded for the same hazard; body prescribes the same try/catch with fall-through to the acquire retry and states the acceptance.

title: parseVerdict reads the first VERDICT: occurrence instead of the final verdict line the prompt demands
reason: analyze.ts:125 anchors findVerdictToken on the first VERDICT_PREFIX occurrence, so the echoable prompt text at :33 ("VERDICT: PRODUCTIVE or VERDICT: UNPRODUCTIVE") wins over the final line and parses PRODUCTIVE (probe reproduced); body prescribes scanning lines from the end and the echoed-format regression test with UNPRODUCTIVE acceptance.

title: captureScreenshot writes its handoff PNG to a predictable /tmp path another local account can pre-plant
reason: capture.ts:57 writes the screenshot handoff to predictable /tmp/hall-monitor-screen-<ms>.png which spectacle (:75) writes through and ffmpeg (:94) reads back, allowing a local symlink pre-plant (CWE-377); body prescribes mkdtemp 0700 (or spectacle -o - piping) with the private-temp-dir acceptance.

title: Capture buffer and verdict-window logic ship without tests despite the package test policy
reason: Only analyze.unit.test.ts and lock.unit.test.ts exist in the package (probe), while the capture buffer store/getRecent/prune (memory.ts:62/:87) and the decision-window/streak policy (cycle.ts:149-182) are pure logic with zero coverage; PKG/TCV named and the body specifies the boundary cases (exact-cutoff, 5-streak trigger, post-notification reset).

reason: rg finds a single //region at cycle.ts:25 while analyze.ts (prompt :21, verdict parsing :64, API call) and lock.ts (:111 utilities, socket lock, /proc scan, takeover) plus llama.ts and capture.ts bundle multiple sections unmarked; ST2 named and the body lists the section groupings per file with the stated acceptance.

reason: in-container.ts:242-247 collapses every Error to { ok: false, output: '' }, discarding nano-spawn SubprocessError stdout/stderr and letting spawn infrastructure failures satisfy expect: 'error' scenarios; body prescribes returning the error's captured output for SubprocessError and rethrowing everything else, with the stated acceptance.

reason: Four non-test catch sites void their binding without logging (xml-coding.ts:72, evaluate-predicate.ts:100, watch-filter.ts:173, mise.generate-index.ts:160, verified by rg), violating LG2; body prescribes tagged-logger debug lines with caughtValueText and rethrow of unexpected error codes, with the no-void-catch acceptance.

title: key-helper source modules contain no //region markers for their logical sections
reason: rg '//region' over package/kwin/key-helper/src returns zero matches while evdev.ts (336 lines) and evdev-parse.ts (243 lines) group several concerns each, against ST2; add region pairs per the stated acceptance.

title: keysToEvdev accepts Object.prototype names such as constructor instead of throwing UnknownKeyError
reason: keys.ts:100-101 looks up EVDEV_KEYS on a plain object so 'constructor' and '__proto__' resolve through Object.prototype and keysToEvdev emits 'function Object()...' tokens instead of throwing UnknownKeyError, breaking the module's security-boundary contract at keys.ts:7; use Object.hasOwn or a Map per the acceptance.

title: sendKeys and launchNewInstance ignore ydotool and launcher exit codes and stderr
reason: keys.ts:152 and launch.ts:215 await once(child, 'close') and discard the (code, signal) arguments with stderr unread, so a nonzero ydotool exit (ydotoold down) looks like success although keys.ts:126 TSDoc promises failure logging (GRW); capture and log per the acceptance.

title: Neovim socket discovery tries only the newest socket and gives up when it is stale
reason: nvim.ts:140 reduces sockets to the single newest by mtime and :162 makes one connect attempt, so a stale nvim.<pid>.<seq> socket from a crashed newer Neovim shadows the live one and F20 delivery stops; walk candidates newest-first per the acceptance.

title: Neovim socket directory hardcodes /run/user/<uid> instead of XDG_RUNTIME_DIR
reason: nvim.ts:55 hardcodes /run/user/${UID} with a DEFAULT_UID 1000 guess at :43 and never consults XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, where Neovim actually places its listen socket (neovim/neovim#3517); resolve XDG_RUNTIME_DIR first and throw when neither exists per the acceptance.

title: Browser resource-class lists in the KWin script and launch.ts drift apart with no owner
reason: main.js:35 BROWSERS (substring match at :51) and launch.ts:33 NEW_WINDOW_OVERRIDES (exact lowercased keys) are two hand-maintained lists that already disagree on membership and match semantics, and the body offers two co-equal owners (build-time generation versus a new D-Bus query method) without picking one or naming which matching rule wins, so both design points stay open.

title: key-helper install task embeds an unquoted repo path into the autostart Exec line
reason: key-helper/mise.toml:114 interpolates binPath raw into an Exec= line that is parsed once by the desktop-entry grammar and again by /bin/sh, so a space or quote in the checkout path breaks autostart (SYB); quote at the final interpolation per the acceptance, the systemd-unit redesign being only an alternative.

title: key-helper install task discards lstat errors with a bare void error
reason: key-helper/mise.toml:95-97 catches lstatSync/readlinkSync errors and voids the binding without logging or rethrowing, hiding permission and symlink corruption behind the absent-link path (LG2); log the caught value or narrow to ENOENT per the acceptance.

title: Aquascope decoder prose points to content by relative position instead of naming the entry or section
reason: learning/rust/reference/aquascope-decoder.html:511 'Every move rule below' and :1131 'every wrapper below' point by relative position against WR5 (AGENTS.md), the only two such hits in the package; name the target entries per the acceptance.

title: README use-list numbered markers are not padded to the four characters MD2 requires
reason: learning/rust/README.md:12-19 write numbered markers as 'N.' plus one space (three columns) while AGENTS.md MD2 requires the padded four-column form; add the extra space per the acceptance.

title: Kotlin detekt verify:central runs detekt-cli 2.0.0-alpha.5 while the plugin builds against 2.0.0-alpha.6
reason: linter/kotlin/build.gradle.kts:38 pins detektVersion 2.0.0-alpha.6 for compileOnly and detektCli while mise.toml:114's verify:central consumer hardcodes detekt-cli 2.0.0-alpha.5, and neither file comments the divergence; align both pins to one declared version per the acceptance.

title: Nearest-configuration discovery is implemented as two separate ancestor walks with no shared owner
reason: config_lookup.rs:222 discover_with_filesystem and run_plan.rs:220 ConfigStore::nearest each hand-write the first-hit ancestor walk for monochromatic-lint.config.jsonc (GRW), and run_plan.rs:189 always passes Some(explicit) so the tested walk is production-dead; one walk owner with the existing tests green satisfies the acceptance, both refactor routes being behavior-neutral.

title: run_process returns exit status 2 silently when a standard-stream write fails
reason: run_process.rs:107 emit() folds write errors to a bool and :240 returns 2 with no message although the module contract at :9 promises every failure leaves the program's explanation (BrokenPipe deliberately excepted); surface the io::Error on the surviving stream per the acceptance.

title: Lint and fuzz bin scripts wrap their top-level logic in an async function main() wrapper
reason: monochromatic-lint/bin/mutate-container.mjs:322, monochromatic-lint.fuzz/bin/container.mjs:57 and planted-controls.mjs:111 wrap dispatch in async function main() with await main(), while the sibling test-container.mjs and clippy-container.mjs use top-level code; inline the bodies to top level per the script-convention standard and the acceptance.

title: mcp stdio and mvm diagnostics use raw console.error with hand-built [mcp-stdio] and [mcp-mvm] tag prefixes
reason: 16 console.error sites in mcp/stdio (transport.ts:156 and siblings) and mcp/mvm (response.ts:87,:123) embed hand-built '[mcp-stdio]'/'[mcp-mvm]' prefixes, against TLG/LG1, while mcp/search-fetch/src/response-store.ts:25 shows the compliant tagged() pattern; adopt tagged loggers on stderr levels per the acceptance.

title: stdio transport logs every inbound line and outbound frame body verbatim at error level
reason: transport.ts:156 and :245 console.error every outbound frame and inbound line verbatim at error severity with no verbosity switch, duplicating tool payloads (web_fetch text, pull_from_vm bytes) into host logs; demote to debug-level tracing behind an explicit opt-in flag per the acceptance.

title: mcp stdio and search-fetch call module-local helpers before their declarations in source order
reason: transport.ts serve (line 131) calls queueFrame/serializeResponse/writeSerializedMessage declared at 336-466, server.ts:163 calls respondResourcesList declared at :189, and search-fetch/src/index.ts:157 calls isDirectlyExecuted declared at :196, against ST8; reorder the declarations per the acceptance.

title: stdio README and TSDoc examples teach `v.strictObject`, the schema builder `strictArguments` exists to replace
reason: stdio/README.md:49 and seven TSDoc examples (server-define-tool.ts:23 and siblings) teach v.strictObject while tool-schema.ts:27-32 documents its Object.prototype hole and strictArguments exists to close it; rewrite the examples per the acceptance.

title: mvm response.ts redeclares the text-content result shapes that mcp-stdio already exports
reason: mvm/src/response.ts:13-29 hand-redeclares TextContent/TextResponse/ErrorResponse while mcp-stdio/src/protocol-tool.ts:114,:236 exports the owned TextContent/ToolCallResult that mvm already depends on (GRW); delete the local copies and import the owned types per the acceptance.

title: search-fetch tools.ts declares a module logger it never uses
reason: search-fetch/src/tools.ts:43 binds const l = tagged({ tag: 'tools', l: searchFetchMcpLogger }) and never calls it (rg 'l.' shows the only log calls in index.ts and response-store.ts), a dead binding that fakes instrumentation (TLG); remove it or actually log per the acceptance.

title: stdio McpServerConfig TSDoc says two cache hints default to DEFAULT_CACHE_HINT where three exist
reason: server-types.ts:132 says 'Both cache hints default to DEFAULT_CACHE_HINT' while the type carries three at :149-154 (discoverCache, toolsCache, resourcesCache); reword to cover all three per the acceptance.

title: search-fetch package.json omits the license field its sibling mcp packages declare
reason: mcp/search-fetch/package.json declares no license key while mvm/package.json:2 and stdio/package.json:2 declare 'LGPL-3.0-or-later' and all three ship the same LICENSES/ copies; add the matching field per the acceptance.

title: mvm test suite leaves seven tool handlers and the response formatting helpers untested
reason: mvm/src/index.unit.test.ts:126's comment claims no tools/call fires although cases at :284,:315,:340 do, and seven handlers (tools-exec.ts:44,:95, tools-lifecycle-mutate.ts:55, tools-transfer.ts:39,:89, tools-lifecycle.ts:32) plus formatExecResult at response.ts:146 are untested (TCV/PKG); add the UNRESOLVABLE_BACKEND cases per the acceptance.

title: search-fetch response store eviction branch has no test that ever exceeds the store capacity
reason: response-store.ts:174's capacity eviction loop and its :183 break never run under test: index.unit.test.ts:128 builds a capacity-4 store and records one response; add the five-record and evicted-read cases per the acceptance.

title: stdio buildToolCallResult spreads handler result after resultType, letting a handler misstate the envelope
reason: server-result.ts:262-266 spreads ...result after resultType but before _meta, so a handler payload carrying resultType replaces the mandated 'complete' discriminator while :237 TSDoc claims handlers cannot misstate envelope fields; move the envelope fields after the spread per the acceptance.

title: MCP request-builder test helper exists in three spellings, two of them violating the named-parameter rule
reason: modernRequest (stdio/server.unit.test.ts:76, destructured object) and serverRequest (search-fetch/src/index.unit.test.ts:87) plus resourceRequest (stdio/server-resources.unit.test.ts:89, three positional params against ST9) hand-write one request-builder three times (GRW); one mcpTestRequest({ id, method, params, version }) owner per the acceptance, either home being behavior-neutral.

title: toml-edit encodeWrapped interpolates wrapper payloads into TOML text without validating them against their kind
reason: value-encoders.ts:50 returns String(wrapped.value) for any wrapper and :101 accepts any object with a string tomlKind, so tomlSet writes payload text verbatim (a '1\nbad = "x"' integer injects a key line, tomlLocalDate('2026-01-01 # x') emits a comment), a SYB boundary hole reachable from conformance/encode-from-tagged.ts:152; validate payload against kind and throw TomlTypeError per the acceptance.

title: toml-edit float encoding loses the sign of negative zero
reason: value-encoders.ts:43 derives float text with String(n) so String(-0) yields '0' and tomlFloat(-0) emits 0.0, losing the -0.0 TOML can express (same loss in values.ts:235); special-case Object.is(n, -0) per the acceptance and mirror or-throw's formatSatisfactionValue handling.

title: toml-edit basic-escape embeds a raw NUL character in the unicodeEscape TSDoc
reason: Already fixed: commit 1667356026 (2026-08-06, 'fix(module-toml-edit): replace raw NUL bytes with their escape in TSDoc') names this exact defect, and a byte scan of all 3689 files under package/module/toml-edit at HEAD finds zero NUL bytes while grep prints matching lines for basic-escape.ts instead of 'binary file matches'; the body's probe claim (Buffer.indexOf(0) is 1579) does not hold on the current tree.

title: Counted-index for loops in toml-edit and deepmerge-ts.fuzz lack the justification comment the standards require
reason: Counted-index for loops at toml-edit/src/parse-toml-edit.ts:53, comments.ts:60, build-comments.ts:140 and deepmerge-ts.fuzz/src/coverage-source.ts:61, campaign.ts:200, surface-type-cost-family.ts:98 carry no justification comment, unlike coverage-v8.ts:122's precedent; convert to the preferred form or annotate each per the acceptance.

title: logger localStorage verification can drop the sink when two tabs probe the shared key at once
reason: local-storage.ts:82 probes the fixed key '__monochromatic_verify__' in every tab and :99 resolves false on any cross-tab overwrite, dropping the sink, while :84's comment claims immunity it lacks (same shape in session-storage.ts:34); give each verification a unique key and fix the comment per the acceptance test.

title: logger createRecordBuffer registers global pagehide and visibilitychange listeners it never removes
reason: record-buffer.ts:208 and :214 register pagehide and visibilitychange listeners per buffer and rg finds no removeEventListener in package/module/logger/src, so each sink pins its closure for the page lifetime; return a dispose threaded through the Sink contract (the acceptance's dispose-and-count route) or one module-scope listener pair, proven by the listener-count test.

title: logger file and OPFS sinks leave a probe record in the log file they verify
reason: sink/file.ts:228-229 and sink/opfs.ts:82 append a {"test":true,...} line to the real log file during verification and never remove it, so the advertised JSONL record stream starts with a non-LogRecord; probe via a sibling file or truncate back per the acceptance.

title: logger file sink write catch reports JSON.stringify failures as append failures
reason: sink/file.ts:288's JSON.stringify is the only throw write's catch can see (appendAfter swallows append failures itself) yet :295 reports 'file sink record append failed', duplicating file-append.ts:38 and mislabeling serialization errors (DGT); separate the serialization step per the acceptance.

title: logger create-logger classifies flush timeouts by matching another package's error message text
reason: create-logger.ts:578 classifies flush timeouts by error.message === `Timed out after ${flushDeadlineMs}ms: logger flush`, string-matching async-time/src/with-timeout.ts:58's message format (PP4 asks a typed error); add a named TimeoutError and match on it per the acceptance.

title: or-throw getSize accepts the container shapes its own contract says it rejects
reason: or-throw/src/size.ts:49 falls through to Object.keys(value).length for every remaining object although the TSDoc at :20 lists WeakSet/WeakMap as intentionally rejected, so emptyOrThrow(new WeakSet()) passes silently (PP8/TCV); reject non-plain objects before that branch per the acceptance.

title: conf-fork config-dir treats empty APPDATA and XDG_CONFIG_HOME as set, breaking upstream path parity
reason: conf-fork/src/config-dir.ts:65 and :96 fall back with ?? so empty APPDATA/XDG_CONFIG_HOME is kept and path.join('', name) goes cwd-relative, while upstream env-paths@4.0.0 uses || and the module header at :6 promises identical paths; switch to falsy-aware fallbacks per the acceptance.

title: conf-fork sources import node:path as a default where the repository standard is named imports
reason: conf-fork spells node:path as a default import at src/watcher.ts:13, config-dir.ts:14 and eight more sites against ST5 and the 315 named-import sites repo-wide (logger/src/sink/file.ts among them); convert to named imports per the acceptance.

title: kv-store hasCycle misreports shared references as cycles and corrupts or rejects the value
reason: kv-store/src/has-cycle.ts:53 uses one global seen set so shared references (a DAG) count as cycles, making serialize.ts:104/:109 throw TypeError or decircular-duplicate acyclic values; use an ancestor path set per the acceptance.

title: kv-store async store writes empty keys under a content hash that get and delete never address
reason: create-store.ts:151 hashes the empty key only in set, while :173 get and :210 delete query the raw key, so set('', v) values are unreachable and undeletable (EC4) although the Store.set TSDoc advertises the derivation as a feature; resolve the storage key in one helper per the acceptance round trip.

title: jsonc-edit read API resolves negative and fractional array path segments its edit API rejects
reason: jsonc-edit/src/edit-navigate.ts:76 resolves array segments with .at(segment) so ['list',-1] and ['list',1.5] read successfully while edit-set.ts:110/:282 and edit-comment.ts:104 reject the same paths (PP8/GRW); share one array-segment validator so get, set, and delete agree per the acceptance.

title: fs-path ensureFile fails with ENOENT on a bare filename by creating an empty parent directory
reason: fs-path/src/ensure.ts:228 passes posix.parse('bare.txt').dir (the empty string) to ensureDir, so ensureFile('bare.txt') dies with ENOENT on mkdir ''; skip empty parent creation per the acceptance.

title: fs-path ensure and empty families disagree on ?query suffixes in the same path spelling
reason: fs-path/src/empty.ts:45 strips ?query before IO while ensure.ts:151 parses the raw spelling, so ensurePath('dist/x.js?raw') creates a literal 'x.js?raw' and emptyPath of the same spelling truncates the unrelated x.js (TWS/GRW); one shared path-cleaning helper gives the identical-target behavior the acceptance pins.

title: kv-store sync and async store twins are hand-written duplicates with no stated sharing arrangement
reason: kv-store hand-writes sync/async twins (create-store.ts vs create-sync-store.ts, heal.ts:20 vs :74, backends-async.ts:32 vs backends-sync.ts:22) with no stated arrangement and they already drift (create-store.ts:151 hashes empty keys, create-sync-store.ts:153 does not); the acceptance accepts any arrangement recorded at the declarations plus the empty-key parity test, and consensus.ts shows the shared seam.

title: image-diff dotProduct silently truncates its sum when a vector contains a sparse element
reason: image-diff/src/similarity.ts:51-55 breaks out of the accumulation loop on an undefined element and returns the prefix dot product as if complete, a silently discarded unexpected state (PP8); throw or validate up front per the acceptance.

title: fs-path ensureFile can truncate a file created between its existence stat and its writeFile
reason: fs-path/src/ensure.ts:229-233 recreates the file with flag 'w' (truncating) after the :220 stat said missing, so a file another process creates in the window is destroyed despite the 'when missing' contract; create with 'wx' and handle EEXIST per the acceptance.

title: make-asynchronous-fork worker-lifecycle throws on non-envelope worker messages instead of dropping them
reason: worker-lifecycle.ts:560 routeReply runs getMessageData (which throws TypeError at :242 for any non-envelope) before checking for a pending request, while worker-source.ts:110 forwards the wrapped function's own postMessage to it and the contract at :9 and comment at :549 promise strays are dropped; drop non-envelopes per the acceptance.

title: memoize-async clear and delete let an in-flight computation repopulate the wiped cache
reason: memoize-async.ts:155-160 awaits store.set unconditionally when a computation settles while clear() at :233-236 and deleteCacheEntry at :238-241 only drop state, so an in-flight write repopulates the wiped cache against the types.ts:164 contract; fence with a generation counter or tombstone per the acceptance test.

title: zip-writer dosDateTime silently wraps dates after 2107 and only half-clamps dates before 1980
reason: zip-writer/src/dos-time.ts:78-89 clamps only the year so 2108-01-01 packs to 65601 and view.setUint16 stores 65 (1980-01-03) while :62 promises earlier dates are clamped, yet 1979-06-15 encodes as 1980-06-15; clamp the whole timestamp to the DOS range per the acceptance boundaries.

title: matrix runContainer prints container stderr through raw console.error instead of a tagged logger
reason: matrix/src/container.ts:300 console.errors a successful run's stderr from the exported library function runContainer (matrix has no bin entry), against TLG/LG1; route through a tagged logger parameter or the result per the acceptance.

title: Fuzz run-budget module fuzzRuns is hand-copied into ten fuzz sidecars with only the env-var name differing
reason: Ten *.fuzz/src/fuzz-budget.ts files hand-copy the same fuzzRuns run-budget module (p-map-fork.fuzz:33, p-memoize-fork.fuzz:33 and siblings, only the env-var name differing, GRW). Verified not a duplicate: #613 owns the V8 coverage harness extraction (its acceptance names campaignBudgetMs/fuzzRunPlan) and #646 owns intra-sidecar duplication, so the ten copies are uncovered; one shared run-budget helper per the acceptance.

title: Callback and nested function declarations across the module packages omit return type annotations
reason: matrix/src/matrix.ts:184, test-diagnostic/src/format-error.ts:279, dom/src/duplicateElement.ts:62 and about 25 more library sites declare callbacks and nested functions without return types, against the annotated house style shown by p-limit-fork/src/p-limit.ts:267; annotate each per the acceptance sweep.

title: Index-counted for loops in fs-id, matcher-fork and zip-writer carry no justification comment
reason: fs-id/src/parsers.ts:249 and :289 count indices for a membership test and a first-space search where functional forms suffice, and matcher-fork/src/pattern.ts:96, case-fold.ts:193, zip-writer/src/crc32.ts:36/:41 carry no justification comment; convert or annotate per the acceptance.

reason: map-iterable-async.ts:41 pushes mapper promises during iteration but Promise.all attaches handlers only at :42 after the source is exhausted, so a mid-iteration rejection is unhandled and Node's default kills the host (PP1/PP2); mark each promise handled at push time per the acceptance probe.

title: createObservable and createObservableAsync duplicate one body without a stated sync/async arrangement
reason: observable/src/create-observable.ts:65,:70 and create-observable-async.ts:79,:84 share 220 of 255 body tokens with no TWS arrangement stated; the body names a fully specified shared-core factory route and the acceptance admits the stated-arrangement route as complete, so no choice blocks implementation.

reason: cache-workload.ts:335,:367,:467 show positional renderPair/renderItem/applyOp calls and coverage-driver.ts:76 shows matcher(1, 'a') though each takes one destructured object (cache-workload.ts:330,:360,:452; matcher-fork/src/index.ts:58); rewrite the @example blocks per the acceptance.

title: flattenCatalogEntries TSDoc ends with a dangling on catalog maps fragment
reason: pnpm-workspace-catalog/src/parse.ts:305 leaves the orphan fragment 'on catalog maps' (tail of a removed @mutates tag) after the @returns line at :303, while parseBlock's tag at :140 reads in full; delete the fragment or restore the complete line per the acceptance, checking the effect claim against the code first.
